descriptionChirho: Qal sense of sinking down into water, mud, or deep mire, whether literal drowning or figurative distress.
Qal sense of sinking or being thrust into a solid substance so as to become fixed or embedded (e.g., feet sinking into ground, gates sinking into earth).
Hofal (causative passive) sense of being caused to sink, be settled, or be fixed in place, whether into water or into the ground.
Pual (intensive passive) sense of being drowned or fully submerged, emphasizing the completeness of the sinking.
